title: More ways to make things
summary:
Nine community apps joined the catalog, Wan video requests got a longer deadline, and Polli acquired a suspicious number of statuses.

The community app catalog added Anime Forge for character design, StoryStudio for illustrated stories with optional narration, Vtrace for raster-to-SVG conversion, and MyEntMap, a multilingual city map with generated watercolor-style storefront images.

Five more community apps joined the catalog: Pollinations AI Studio combines model chat and image generation; AI Health Studio focuses on wellness; Lumina Chat and French-language Le petit AI offer chat interfaces; and Driftpod.fm helps people discover podcasts. The Greenhouse count reached 848 apps.

Wan 2.7 text-to-video and image-to-video requests through `wan-pro` and `wan-pro-1080p` now have a 15-minute prediction deadline, while other Replicate models keep six minutes. The SDK’s default video request timeout rose to 20 minutes so it can wait for generation and the final media transfer.
